Name: Joja Lottery
Author: AirynS
Description:
Win every day with Joja Lottery™️! Is today YOUR lucky day?!*

To play, use the Joja Lottery™️ machine in your local JojaMart™️ where each day you can purchase a Joja Lottery™️ ticket for 500g. How much you’ve won is a mystery until you’ve redeemed it - is your luck good enough to win the 10,000g jackpot?! Ship your redeemed ticket to the provided address to receive your prize and find out!

*Note: As per Ferngill legislation, Joja Co. encourages all patrons to gamble responsibly. Patrons are limited to one ticket purchase per day. Joja Lottery™️ machines are unaffected by magic, spirits, and other external luck-altering sources. Joja does not take responsibility for any losses or damages caused by retired or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8804]black market[/url] versions of Joja Lottery™️ machines.

[line]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]

Joja Lottery only requires Content Patcher.

[size=4][b]How to Use[/b][/size]:

[spoiler]
A new lottery machine will be added next to Morris's desk in JojaMart (or in the bus tunnel - see Compatibility). Buy a redeemed lottery ticket, exit the lottery shop, then re-enter to redeem your ticket. Your redeemed ticket can then be placed in the shipping bin to receive your prize money.
[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size]:

[/b]Joja Lottery has additional compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8804]Joja Blackmarket[/url] by CopperSun! If Blackmarket is installed, a second lottery machine will be available in the bus tunnel. It may not be in the best condition, however…

You can also now enable the bus tunnel lottery machine by choosing "true" or "OnlyAfterCC" (if you have completed the Community Centre) in the EnableBlackmarketLottery config option.

Joja Lottery may or may not be incompatible with SVE. I have not tested Joja Lottery with SVE, and [b]I will not offer compatibility with SVE[/b]. Use them together at your own risk. Bug reports or comments involving SVE compatibility will be deleted.

The Portuguese translation was created by Kanadeyoru.

Downloads.Description: To install, extract the Joja Lottery folder and drop into your Mods folder.
